source: Indian Academy of Pediatrics Advisory Committee on Vaccines and Immunization Practices (IAP-ACVIP): Recommended Immunization Schedule 2023, Table I 'Vaccines for Routine Use'. Rao MIS et al., Indian Pediatrics 2024;61:113-124. https://www.indianpediatrics.net/feb2024/113.pdf
disclaimer: Ages are in completed weeks/months/years. Brands and combination vaccines change some details (noted below). Always follow the schedule your child's pediatrician gives you.

schedule.notes: BCG before discharge; OPV as soon as possible after birth; Hepatitis B within 24 hours of birth.
DTwP or DTaP may be used for primary immunization. IPV schedule is 6-10-14 weeks.
RV1 (GSK) rotavirus vaccine is a 2-dose schedule; all other rotavirus brands are 3-dose.
A 4th Hepatitis B dose is safe and permitted as part of a combination vaccine. Rotavirus-3 is not needed with RV1 (GSK).
Uniform dose of 0.5 mL from 6 months.
Second dose 4 weeks after the first. Then repeat every year, in the pre-monsoon period, until 5 years of age.
A single dose is enough for the live attenuated Hepatitis A vaccine; the inactivated vaccine needs two doses.
Hepatitis A-2 only for the inactivated vaccine. Varicella-2 is given 3-6 months after dose 1.
Annual influenza vaccination for all children until 5 years; beyond 5 years for those at high risk.
Tdap should not be used as the second DTP booster at 4-6 years.
Recommended for both girls and boys from the 2023 schedule.
Given even if Tdap was given earlier as the second DTP booster. If Tdap is unavailable or unaffordable, Td can be used.

vaccines: HPV (3 doses, 0-2-6 months, if not given earlier)

afterCareSource: Parento editorial guidance. Not part of the IAP table.
afterCare: Mild fever, fussiness, and redness or swelling where the injection was given are common for 1-2 days and usually settle on their own.
Keep feeding normally and comfort your child. Ask your doctor before giving any fever medicine.
Get medical help urgently for difficulty breathing, swelling of the face or lips, a seizure, crying that will not stop for 3 hours or more, or unusual drowsiness.
